run_download_dataset: run the CLI to download a dataset using a JSON config file with --download_config
run_download_to_dest: run the CLI to download dataset files to a custom directory with --dest
review_download_tar: review the download_tar function that fetches tar files from S3 and filters by entity type
review_checksum: review the checksum function that validates downloaded tar files against MD5 checksums
review_unzip: review the unzip function that uses multiprocessing to extract tar files in parallel
